<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Shipping" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Goods Shipping" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Shipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ShipNeeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipper</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_AmountType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ShipMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics Department Head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_InsuranceNeeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_InsuranceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehousemen" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Shipping" name="Goods to be shipped">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToShipNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ShipNeeded" name="Goods shall be shipped?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToShipNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShipYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShipNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClarifyToAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AmountType" name="Large amounts?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClarifyToAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LargeAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SmallAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LargeAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InviteToSelect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Select one logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InviteToSelect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SmallAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ShipMerge" name="Shipping method determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_ParallelSplit" name="Start parallel preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToInsuranceCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToPackage</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_InsuranceNeeded" name="Parcel insurance necessary?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToInsuranceCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Take out parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_InsuranceMerge" name="Insurance handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceMergeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToPackage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackageToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_ParallelJoin" name="Preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceMergeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackageToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToPickup</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToPickup</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickupToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickupToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoShipping" name="No shipping required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipNo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToShipNeeded" sourceRef="Start_Shipping" targetRef="Gw_ShipNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_ShipNeeded" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_ShipNeeded" targetRef="End_NoShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarifyToAmount" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gw_AmountType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large amounts" sourceRef="Gw_AmountType" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small amounts" sourceRef="Gw_AmountType" targetRef="Task_NormalPost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToSelect" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gw_ShipMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gw_ShipMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToSplit" sourceRef="Gw_ShipMerge" targetRef="Gw_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToLabel" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToInsuranceCheck" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Gw_InsuranceNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPackage" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_InsuranceNeeded" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_InsuranceNeeded" targetRef="Gw_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToMerge" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gw_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gw_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gw_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToJoin" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gw_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gw_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPickup" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickupToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="End_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
